# Custom Message Type

注册 OrderCard，不修改 MessageBubble 或内置 dispatcher。

## Vue Preview

<ComponentPreview name="MessageContentView" />

## Registry

### Vue

~~~vue
import { provideFlareMessageRenderers } from "@flare-im/vue-ui";
import OrderCard from "./OrderCard.vue";
provideFlareMessageRenderers({ order: OrderCard });
~~~

### Flutter

~~~dart
FlareContentRegistry.register('order',
  (context, content, ctx) => OrderCard(content: content, isSelf: ctx.self),
);
~~~

### Android Compose

~~~kotlin
FlareContentRegistry.register("order") { content, context ->
    OrderCard(content = content, isSelf = context.isSelf)
}
~~~

### SwiftUI

~~~swift
FlareContentRegistry.register("order") { content, context in
    AnyView(OrderCard(content: content, isSelf: context.isSelf))
}
~~~

## Capabilities and Actions

OrderCard 的业务动作通过 MessageCapabilities 与 host action extensions 提供，主题只消费 semantic/component tokens。

## Fallback

未注册或无法解码时使用 UnknownMessage，保留原始类型、诊断和恢复入口。
